UeberUns.headline: Voices from the team
UeberUns.subline: Quotes & positive feedback – straight from the festival tent.
UeberUns.photo_caption: Your uniform, once you're part of it

voices.name: Sepp
voices.quote: I pour faster than guests can get thirsty – and that's exactly how it should be.
voices.spruch: A beer without foam is like a festival without brass music.

voices.name: Lena
voices.quote: Tray full, heart full: when the guests laugh, my evening is perfect.
voices.spruch: I carry eight steins at once – just not the responsibility.

voices.name: Michi
voices.quote: From empty field to festival tent in two days – that's our little miracle.
voices.spruch: I don't just put up tents, I put up good mood.

voices.name: Anna
voices.quote: When the roast pork smells, guests forget their phones for a moment.
voices.spruch: Love goes through the stomach – with us through the whole hall.

voices.name: Resi
voices.quote: After the festival is before the festival – and in between there's cake at my place.
voices.spruch: Coffee black, costume colourful, mood golden.

Hero.subtitle: Experience authentic celebrations with a modern twist. From small village festivals to exclusive event gastronomy – we bring the traditional host into the present.

About.title: Welcome to Maurerwirt!
About.subtitle: Bavarian Roots. Modern Celebrations.
About.p1: I am Florian Maurer – known to many simply as "Maurerwirt". With roots in the Halbauer butchery, I learned early on what quality and genuine hospitality mean. Today, I bring this tradition into the modern event world.
About.p2: Whether it's a traditional folk festival, an elegant company anniversary, or a very personal club party – we combine Bavarian warmth with precise planning and professional equipment.
About.quote: “A good party doesn't plan itself, but it should feel like it does.”
About.p3: Let's work together to create an event that your guests will remember fondly for a long time.

Identity.intro: We don't come from the event industry, we come from the inn parlour and the festival tent. You can feel that in every detail: in our kitchen, our service and our music.

values.title: Organic & quality
values.text: What ends up on the table has an origin: preferably organic produce and growers we shake hands with personally.

values.title: Regionality
values.text: Short routes, real value creation: butchery, brewery and vegetables from Upper Bavaria instead of anonymous wholesale markets.

values.title: Craft & tradition
values.text: Festival tent culture with roots: from grilled fish to brass music – genuine instead of staged.

values.title: Solidarity
values.text: Clubs, families, companies: we celebrate with you, not just for you – reliably from the first idea to the last measure.
